last_session.ai_analysis: Current positions in GLD and TLT already capture the defensive bias. With cash reserves thin, adding new exposure would violate risk limits. The best move is to wait for a clear dislocation—such as a spike in VIX or a break in equity momentum—before deploying the remaining capital into a large, concentrated bet on safety assets.
last_session.outlook: Markets are exhibiting extreme complacency with relentless buying in tech and emerging markets, while the dollar remains subdued. This sets up a classic reflexive bubble; the next shock will likely come from a sudden flight to safety, driving gold and long-term bonds higher as liquidity drains.
